mentions.name: Weekly Thanksgiving cooking challenge
mentions.description: A personal weekly cooking challenge run through October and November to practice and refine a Thanksgiving day feast, with each week focused on a different dish or element such as brussels sprouts, cauliflower, and the classic sage, rosemary, and thyme seasoning blend, building up to the final meal.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the month of November (and starting in October this year) I like to hold weekly cooking challenges to practice and refine my Thanksgiving day feast. Now about 3 weeks out from the final boss level of cooking, and I'm having a week all about brussel sprouts. Earlier weeks were cauliflower and the classic seasoning blend of sage, rosemary and thyme.
mentions.author: skyberrys
